program_summary.description: Builds an analysis-ready file at the sampled establishment level for a single reference period, by merging raw collected microdata with a control file, applying a retention filter, and writing the result to a caller-specified library; also aggregates totals by state_fips for review.

macro_reference.name: mkrun3
macro_reference.purpose: Merges D1 and D2 to produce O1 for reference period `p`, applying a 4-step pipeline (sort/merge, summarize, derive, transpose).

variable_dictionary.name: ESTID
variable_dictionary.label: Establishment identifier
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: ST
variable_dictionary.label: State FIPS code
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: PER
variable_dictionary.label: Reference period YYYYMM
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through from the input file when populated; if blank, backfilled from the &dt macro variable set at the top of the program.

variable_dictionary.name: SEP
variable_dictionary.label: Total separations
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets.

variable_dictionary.name: WGTF
variable_dictionary.label: Final sampling weight
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets.

variable_dictionary.name: EMPL
variable_dictionary.label: Total employment level
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets.

variable_dictionary.name: JO
variable_dictionary.label: Job openings count
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets.

variable_dictionary.name: HIR
variable_dictionary.label: Total hires
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets.

variable_dictionary.name: SEPR
variable_dictionary.label: Total separations expressed as a rate per 100 units
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed as round(100*SEP/SEP, 0.01) when SEP > 0, else set to missing.

variable_dictionary.name: ST
variable_dictionary.label: State FIPS code
variable_dictionary.derivation: grouping variable carried through from the class statement (ST).

variable_dictionary.name: SEP
variable_dictionary.label: Total separations (mean across records)
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed via PROC SUMMARY as the mean of this variable across records sharing the same ST (name unchanged from the input -- the `mean=;` output statement was not given explicit new names).

variable_dictionary.name: WGTF
variable_dictionary.label: Final sampling weight (mean across records)
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed via PROC SUMMARY as the mean of this variable across records sharing the same ST (name unchanged from the input -- the `mean=;` output statement was not given explicit new names).
